CONNECT WAKE SO

Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)

Camera Registration and Integration Program

I. Introduction

The Wake County Sheriff’s Office (“WCSO”) is committed to enhancing the safety and

quality of life for those who live, work, and visit Wake County. Privately owned security

cameras located throughout the community may capture valuable information related to

criminal activity or emergency situations. To strengthen collaboration with the

community, WCSO has partnered with Axon Enterprise, Inc. (“Axon”) to utilize their

secure video and data collaboration platform. Through the use of advanced technology,

participating property owners may choose to register their privately owned camera

systems with WCSO, allowing the agency to build an interactive map of the cameras'

locations should footage be needed during an emergency or investigation. Property

owners may also elect to further participate by securely integrating compatible camera

systems through a FususCORE integration device, which enables the sharing of video

with the Sheriff's Office when needed to support emergency response, criminal

investigations, and other legitimate law enforcement purposes.

II. Purpose

The purpose of this Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) is to establish Connect.

Wake.SO as a voluntary program through which Community Participants (“Participants”)

may register the existence and general location of privately-owned security cameras with

the Wake County Sheriff’s Office (“WCSO”). WCSO will use Registration Information to

build and maintain an interactive map or database for consultation during emergencies,

public safety incidents, and investigations of criminal activity in the area. Participation is

voluntary, is not required, and may be withdrawn at any time as set forth herein.

Participants may also voluntarily elect to integrate compatible camera systems with

WCSO through the Fusus platform. Integration allows participating camera systems to

securely share video with WCSO in accordance with the terms of this MOU, to assist with

emergency response and criminal investigations.

III. Scope and Use of Registration Information

a. WCSO may collect the following Registration Information from Participants:

name and role or affiliation, phone number, email address, physical address

Page 1 of 7for the Camera or a general location description, Camera type and

approximate placement, general fields of view, whether footage is stored and

the typical retention period, preferred method and hours of contact, and any

access limitations or conditions the Participant wishes to identify.

b. Registration Information shall be sufficiently general so as not to disclose

sensitive technical details that could compromise the Participant’s security.

WCSO does not require, and the Participant is not obligated to provide,

passwords or direct system access.

c. Providing Registration Information does not constitute consent to enter onto

property or to access any Camera or footage without separate,

contemporaneous consent or valid legal process.

d. WCSO will use Registration Information for the following purposes: to identify

and contact Participants to request relevant footage or assistance during an

Emergency/Incident, to support internal operational planning, and to maintain

and consult the Map/Database for public safety purposes.

e. WCSO will not sell Registration Information. Disclosure may occur only as

provided herein.

IV. Footage Access and Requests

a. Any request for footage or related assistance is voluntary and subject to the

Participant’s consent. The Participant may decline any request or may

condition cooperation on WCSO’s obtaining legal process.

b. WCSO may seek legal process, including a warrant, court order, or subpoena,

when required by law.

c. The Participant agrees, when willing and able, to respond in good faith to

Requests within a reasonable period, which the parties acknowledge may vary

depending on circumstances.

d. Secure transfer methods may include in-person transfer of media, secure file-

sharing links provided or approved by WCSO, encrypted email, or other

mutually acceptable secure means. WCSO will provide reasonable guidance

regarding secure transfer options and will not require the Participant to incur

fees to adopt specialized technology without the Participant’s consent.

V. Participant Responsibilities

a. The Participant is solely responsible for the installation, operation,

maintenance, and lawful placement and use of its Camera system, including

Page 2 of 7compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, ordinances, and

regulations, and with any private covenants or property agreements.

b. The Participant will provide WCSO with at least one point of contact and will

use reasonable efforts to keep Registration Information accurate and current,

including contact details and retention periods.

c. The Participant makes no representation or guarantee that any Camera will

capture an Emergency/Incident or that requested footage will be available,

usable, or retrievable.

VI. WCSO Responsibilities

a. WCSO will maintain the Map/Database and use Registration Information

solely as described in this MOU.

b. WCSO will designate a program coordinator and provide contact information

for program communications.

c. WCSO does not promise, and this MOU does not create, any obligation for

increased patrols, priority response, or altered response times to any location.

d. WCSO does not undertake a duty to monitor, maintain, or use any particular

Registration Information, nor to contact the Participant in any given

Emergency/Incident.

e. WCSO will only access video sources designated by Participant for fusion into

WCSO’s video fusion software.

f. WCSO will not share access to Participant’s camera views with members of

the public. Further, WCSO will ensure video access is strictly limited to

personnel responsible for monitoring the system. Only authorized WCSO

users will have access to the entire camera registry map.

g. Except as otherwise required by law or valid legal process, WCSO will direct

routine third-party inquiries concerning a Participant’s video sources to the

Participant’s designated point of contact. Nothing in this MOU limits the

authority of a court, prosecuting agency, or other authorized entity to issue a

subpoena, court order, or other lawful request for footage or related records.

Each party remains responsible for responding to legal process directed to

records within its possession, custody, or control.

VII. Disclaimers and No Warranties

a. Connect.Wake.SO, the Map/Database, and any related tools, services, or

communications are provided “as is” and “as available,” without warranties of

Page 3 of 7any kind, whether express, implied, or statutory, including any implied

warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-

infringement, accuracy, or availability, to the maximum extent permitted by

law.

b. WCSO does not guarantee crime prevention, any particular investigative

outcome, or any emergency response result, and does not warrant that

Registration Information will be accurate, complete, current, or free from error.

c. In no event will either party be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental,

special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages of any kind, including

but not limited to lost revenues, profits, or goodwill, for any matter arising out

of or in connection with the performance or nonperformance of this

agreement.

VIII. No Duty and No Guarantee

a. Nothing in this MOU creates a special duty of care or an obligation by WCSO

to monitor or to act upon any Registration Information, to contact any

Participant, or to request or obtain any footage.

b. The Participant acknowledges that public safety outcomes depend on

numerous factors beyond WCSO’s control, and that reliance on the program

is at the Participant’s own risk.

IX. Limitation of Liability

a. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Wake County, the Sheriff, Wake

County Sheriff’s Office and its officers, employees, agents, and assigns shall

not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special, exemplary, or

punitive damages, or for lost profits, loss of goodwill, loss of data, interruption,

or other intangible losses arising out of or related to this MOU, participation in

Connect.Wake.SO, errors or omissions in the Map/Database, data breaches

not caused by WCSO’s gross negligence or willful misconduct, or reliance on

Registration Information.

X. Indemnification

a. To the fullest extent permitted by North Carolina law, the Participant shall

indemnify and hold harmless Wake County, the Sheriff, Wake County Sheriff’s

Office and its officers, employees, and agents from and against any and all

Page 4 of 7third-party claims, demands, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and

expenses (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) arising out of or related to the

Participant’s installation, operation, or use of any Camera or device; unlawful

recording or failure to comply with applicable laws; infringement of third-party

rights; or information or footage provided by the Participant, except to the

extent caused by WCSO’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.

XI. Waiver and Release

a. To the maximum extent permitted by North Carolina law, the Participant

releases and waives any and all claims against Wake County, the Sheriff, Wake

County Sheriff’s Office and it officers, employees, and agents arising out of or

related to participation in Connect.Wake.SO? the Map/Database, or WCSO’s

use of Registration Information as contemplated by this MOU, except where

such waiver is prohibited by law or to the extent arising from the WCSO’s gross

negligence or willful misconduct.

XII. No Waiver of Sovereign Immunity

a. Parties agree that nothing herein shall be construed to mandate purchase of

insurance by Sheriff pursuant to N.C.G.S. §153A-435; or to be inconsistent

with Wake County’s “Resolution Regarding Limited Waiver of Sovereign

Immunity” enacted October 6, 2003; or to in any other way waive Sheriff’s or

Wake County’s defense of sovereign or government immunity from any cause

of action alleged or brought against Sheriff or Wake County for any reason if

otherwise available as a matter of law.

XIII. Governing Law; Venue

a. This Agreement shall be governed, interpreted, and enforced pursuant to the

laws of the State of North Carolina. Any action, proceeding, suit, or claim shall

be initiated in courts located in Wake County, North Carolina.

XIV. Public Records Compliance

a. Nothing in this MOU shall be construed to require either party to act contrary

to applicable law. WCSO shall comply with applicable public records laws.

Page 5 of 7XV. Term; Withdrawal; Termination

a. This MOU becomes effective when fully executed and continues until

terminated as provided herein.

b. Participants may withdraw from Connect.Wake.SO at any time by providing

written notice to the WCSO. WCSO will use reasonable efforts to remove

Registration Information and/or Integration Access.

c. WCSO may suspend or terminate Connect.Wake.SO or this MOU in whole or

in part at any time, with or without cause, upon written notice to the

Participant or by general public notice where individual notice is

impracticable.

XVI. Severability

a. If any provision of this MOU is held invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the

remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect to the maximum

extent permitted by law.

XVII. Entire Agreement

a. This MOU constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect

to the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous

communications and understandings, whether written or oral, relating to the

same subject matter.

XVIII. Miscellaneous

a. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation. Failure to

enforce any provision shall not constitute a waiver. This MOU does not create

an agency, partnership, joint venture, or employment relationship between the

parties.

XIX. Acknowledgement

a. By participating in the program and executing this MOU, the Participant

acknowledges understanding of the voluntary nature of Connect.Wake.SO and

agrees that Registration Information and Camera Integration may be used by

WCSO as described herein.
